_note: ADR-045 #D: the Master Data Management steward surface is owned by OpenRegister, not pipelinq. The app-local MDM pages (Master data / Master-entity detail / Data quality / Duplicates / Trust configuration / Sync queue) and their bespoke views/sections/modals were removed; the masterEntity schema now carries x-openregister-survivorship + x-openregister-merge so OR materialises the golden record and hosts the steward views. This fragment keeps ONE deep-link nav entry into OR's Data-Quality surface. OR's quality index uses an in-page register+schema selector (RegisterSchemaSelector), not query params, so the deep-link lands on OR's Data-Quality page and the steward selects the pipelinq register + masterEntity schema there.
